name: Alkeris
summary: Alkeris is an analytical fighter who bores opponents with tedious presentations and uses hot, excessive coffee as a hazard.

source.parsed_text:
Alkeris is ...


Special moves:
- Brings out tons of spreadsheets, power point presentations, blue prints boring you to death with excessive details
- Brews a fine cup of coffee, sips it, throws it in the air to have it rain down in excessive fashion burning the player if in range

inferred_stats.reason: Meticulous preparation, blueprint defense, and low direct physical power

expressions.idle: Calm, analytical smirk while checking a clipboard
expressions.attack: Intensely focused with narrowed eyes behind glasses
expressions.victory: Smug, satisfied grin while straightening a tie

victory_pose: Alkeris neatly adjusts his glasses, checks his watch, and casually tucks a stack of blueprints under his arm.
taunts: Let me explain where you went wrong.
This was all accounted for in my calculations.

specials.name: Tedious Presentation
specials.description: Brings out tons of spreadsheets, power point presentations, blue prints boring you to death with excessive details
specials.shout: As you can see on chart B!
pose_frames: Unfolds a massive stack of blueprints and papers forward
Holds up a shining laser pointer while tapping a clipboard
specials.prop: A towering stack of detailed paper spreadsheets, blueprints, and holographic chart displays

specials.name: Excessive Espresso
specials.description: Brews a fine cup of coffee, sips it, throws it in the air to have it rain down in excessive fashion burning the player if in range
pose_frames: Leans back taking a quick, refined sip from a porcelain cup
Tosses the mug violently upward into the sky
specials.prop: A steaming porcelain coffee cup bursting into scalding droplets of dark liquid
